wins: Reached advanced reconnaissance stage quickly, collecting service banners and version details on 6 hosts
Executed automated vulnerability scans with custom nmap scripts, yielding prioritized CVE targets
Maintained high reward curve (67.5) without triggering detection rules, demonstrating stealthy actions
fails: Failed to achieve final exploitation/persistence stage, keeping success rate at 0%
Consistently misconfigured post-exploitation pivots, leaving no stable foothold for repeated access
Ignored critical known exploit for discovered Apache 2.4.52 vulnerability, resulting in stalled progress
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and scanning phases performed strongly, but lack of follow-through exploitation prevented episode success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Cessation after service enumeration without exploiting identified vulnerabilities

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 is exposed with HTTP headers indicating Apache 2.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap http-vuln-cve2014-3704 and http-vuln-cve2017-5638 scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner reveals OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Execute ssh enumeration using nmap --script ssh2-enum-algos and hydra for weak credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When web application exposes login endpoint
skill_cards.then_action: Chain Burp Intruder with wordlist attack followed by sqlmap on injectable parameters

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying exploitable Apache services
SSH enumeration consistently produced valid user information
